preconditions.description: The number of rows in the land plot is at least 3 and at most 300.
The number of columns in the land plot is at least 3 and at most 300.
The desired time to cover the track is at least 1 and at most 10^9.
The time to cover flat ground, ascend, and descend are all at least 1 and at most 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= height <= 10^6 for height in land_heights)
preconditions.description: The height of each square in the land plot is a positive integer not exceeding 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output rectangle contains the track and all its sides are at least 3 squares long.
The output rectangle covers the track and all its sides are within the land plot.
The output rectangle minimizes the difference between the time to cover the track and the desired time t.
